dog.description_text:
Meet Olaf! 🐾

Olaf is a sweet, playful, and curious boy with a big personality! He’s incredibly affectionate, loves attention, and enjoys exploring his surroundings. He has a lot of love to give, but he’s still working on some basic manners and would benefit from a patient, experienced adopter.

Behavior with Other Dogs

Olaf has been great with my dog! They sniffed each other, got acquainted, and Olaf was perfectly relaxed and happy to coexist. He seems comfortable sharing his space with other dogs.

Eating Habits

Olaf has a healthy appetite and has been eating well with no issues.

Walks & Leash Manners

Olaf loves going on walks and exploring! He tends to pull on the leash and can get quite excited, so he would benefit from continued leash training. He’s curious about his surroundings but can occasionally become nervous or startled by unfamiliar situations.

House Training & Obedience

Olaf is not yet housebroken and has been prone to accidents indoors, even with regular walks. I suspect he may have previously had access to a yard, as he doesn’t seem accustomed to waiting until he’s outside to relieve himself. He’s also still learning basic commands and boundaries and can be a little stubborn at times. He would benefit from consistent, positive reinforcement training and a predictable routine.

Overall Personality

Olaf is an incredibly sweet, affectionate, and playful boy who loves being close to his people. While he has some training needs and can become defensive when frightened, he has so much potential in the right environment. He would do best with a patient, understanding adopter who can help him build confidence, establish a routine, and continue working on his manners. With the right guidance, Olaf could make a wonderful and loving companion!

﻿Olaf is approximately 5y 9m 10d old and is fully grown at 55 pounds. They are microchipped and up to date on all age-appropriate medical care. Their breed is unknown as we have not had a DNA test done.

Although our dogs are listed as unknown breed, buildings with specific dog restrictions typically enforce their rules based on what breeds a dog appears to resemble. It's always important to keep that in mind and know your building's policies before adopting a dog.

This dog is available for adoption through Muddy Paws Rescue. If you're interested in adopting, the first thing you should do is begin the registration process at www.muddypawsrescue.org. If you are already a registered adopter with Muddy Paws Rescue, please email us at adoptionmeetings@muddypawsrescue.org.
